verdict.rationale: Mastra Knowledge is a shared, scoped knowledge layer that developer-built agents read from and write to through tools such as `knowledge_list`. The evidence shows no built-in AI assistant inside the product that a user can delegate tasks to. The Studio Knowledge page is only a tree and graph viewer, and agent read/write access is a developer building block for constructing assistants, which earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
